# telnyx_external_connections (Data Source)

Lists external connections, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_external_connection`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_connection_name_contains` (String) If present, connections with <code>connection_name</code> containing the given value will be returned. Matching is not case-sensitive. Requires at least three characters.
- `filter_created_at` (String) If present, connections with <code>created_at</code> date matching the given YYYY-MM-DD date will be returned.
- `filter_external_sip_connection` (String) If present, connections with <code>external_sip_connection</code> matching the given value will be returned. One of `operator_connect`, `zoom`.
- `filter_id` (String) If present, connections with <code>id</code> matching the given value will be returned.
- `filter_phone_number_contains` (String) If present, connections associated with the given phone_number will be returned. A full match is necessary with a e164 format.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `external_connections` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_connections))

<a id="nestedatt--external_connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_connections`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Specifies whether the connection can be used.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `credential_active` (Boolean) If the credential associated with this service is active.
- `external_sip_connection` (String) The service that will be consuming this connection.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `inbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_connections--inbound))
- `outbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_connections--outbound))
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the connection.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
- `webhook_api_version` (String) Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.
- `webhook_event_failover_url` (String) The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.
- `webhook_event_url` (String) The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.
- `webhook_timeout_secs` (Number) Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.

<a id="nestedatt--external_connections--inbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_connections.inbound`

Read-Only:

- `channel_limit` (Number) When set, this will limit the number of concurrent inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.


<a id="nestedatt--external_connections--outbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_connections.outbound`

Read-Only:

- `channel_limit` (Number) When set, this will limit the number of concurrent outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.
- `outbound_voice_profile_id` (String) Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.
